title: Variety records: cereals (e.g. maize, rice, wheat, sorghum) (open sources)
context: cereals (e.g. maize, rice, wheat, sorghum) are important crops with openly-documented varieties in gene banks and public catalogs.
objective: Compile documented variety records for cereals (e.g. maize, rice, wheat, sorghum) from open sources, following the schema with a citation and license per record.
acceptanceCriteria: >=15 records across >=2 cereals (e.g. maize, rice, wheat, sorghum), each with source + license
No proprietary catalogs or agronomic advice
